slots.role: Sender, subject, event: word by word
slots.visualRecipe: Near-white ground, one small accent-coloured element dead centre at 8-30% width. Three versions: mark with name, one word, two words.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard swaps at 0.97 s and 1.43 s. Each version scales from 60% with expo-out over 8 frames, then drifts about 5% over the rest.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: low level, sparse, no impacts. Energy about a quarter of what comes later.

copySlot.purpose: Mark, then what this is, then the event's name

slots.role: One word saying it is happening now
slots.visualRecipe: Saturated accent ground. White condensed capitals, 29% width. Concentric rings at 8% contrast.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in. Word and rings push from 60% to 100% in 10 frames, expo-out, then reverse drift.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: first soft accent on the cut.

slots.role: The headline value, ending in a rising chart
slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground. Number in accent colour, 18% width, then five centred bars with a slight dark-to-light gradient.
slots.motionRecipe: Linear rollup over 7 frames, hold, bars rise in at 3.43 s with stagger, plateau 6 frames, surge to full in 3 frames. Bars finish exactly as the next ground.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: riser into the fill.

copySlot.purpose: The headline value as one number

slots.role: How often or how it repeats
slots.visualRecipe: Same ground the chart became. White capitals, 61% width.
slots.motionRecipe: Rises from 75% of frame height to centre, expo-out over 8 frames, then slow drift upward.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: no hit, carried by the riser's tail.

slots.role: Two product facts on dark
slots.visualRecipe: Black ground with one barely visible shape. White neutral grotesque at 30% width, grey second line under it.
slots.motionRecipe: First line builds word by word from 5.03 s; its figure rolls for 10 frames. Swap to the second fact at 5.7 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: section stays quiet. Do not impact here; this is the rest.

copySlot.purpose: Fact with a number; fact with a number

slots.role: A symbol of the category lands in a card, which shows the range
slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground. Glossy object arrives oversized at right; one data card at 25% width; later a row of cards with depth of field.
slots.motionRecipe: Object spins past edge-on, decelerates and lands in the card's icon slot by 7.2 s. Card swaps content every 6-12 frames. From 8.46 s scale down with blur, reveal neighbours. Row slides left until the cut.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: section lifts around 9.7 s (measured energy 0.18 to 0.46), so build the card row into that rise.

slots.role: Our own interface doing the one action
slots.visualRecipe: Dark ground, real interface at natural size, 60% of the width, slightly soft at the edges.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in on the first frame of the raised energy. Values change by themselves while the view scrolls up (rollup, then slider). From 12.7 s the primary button brightens from both edges and grows; label shrinks.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: small ticks for each value change. Lands on a transient at the cut.

copySlot.purpose: One short control label, from our real interface

slots.role: What the action could reach
slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground, number at 28% width, half-circle of roughly 90-100 radial ticks running off the frame.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut before the button fills. Expo-out in 20 frames with ticks tied to the value; hold 0.5 s with slow pull-out.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: rising tick, then cut on a transient.

slots.role: Three-beat imperative
slots.visualRecipe: Accent ground. Word 1 at 56% width with a growing underline, word 2 at 35%, word 3 at 88%.
slots.motionRecipe: Two hard swaps at 14.97 s and 15.5 s. Word 3 grows slowly through its hold.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: each swap on a transient. Keep them uneven: 0.6, 0.53, 0.87 s.

copySlot.purpose: How to join, in three words or groups

slots.role: A gain running up
slots.visualRecipe: White ground, green number at 45% width.
slots.motionRecipe: Linear rollup all the way through, slow pull-out. Never settles: the cut takes it.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: quiet continuous tick.

slots.role: The viewer shown at the desired outcome, among others
slots.visualRecipe: Accent ground, long list in a card, one wider row pinned at centre with the gain from the previous slot and a label for the viewer.
slots.motionRecipe: List streams with motion blur; settles in 0.5 s; slides until the pinned row is on top. Hard punch-in at 18.57 s to the top four rows; sheen crosses the first row.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: hit on the cut in, hit on the punch-in.

slots.role: A threshold number, then what it means
slots.visualRecipe: Accent ground with one faint related picture. Word and number, 70% width, heavy. Then a two-line sentence at 56% of that size.
slots.motionRecipe: Word arrives low and shifts as digits open; 13-frame power1.out (near-even steps slowing at the end) rollup; hard cut at 20.03 s; second line arrives word by word within 3 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: on transients.

slots.role: The largest single value, with a tag
slots.visualRecipe: White ground with a faint engraving. Black heavy number at 35% width; skewed accent tag under it overlapping the figure.
slots.motionRecipe: Linear rollup over 14 frames; tag wipes in from the left at 21.0 s; drift.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: hit as the tag lands.

copySlot.purpose: The value and what it is for

slots.role: Full details on a physical object
slots.visualRecipe: Black ground. One curled paper sheet tilted 10 degrees, soft sheen.
slots.motionRecipe: Unrolls towards the camera with a new row about every 2 frames for 0.5 s; slow pull-back.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: dry mechanical ticks would suit; check against our own mix.

copySlot.purpose: Title and short list of real values

slots.role: Time collapses to zero
slots.visualRecipe: Black ground, three white figures with dim suffix letters, 45% width.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard cut in. Figures change every frame for 1.3 s. Hold on zero 0.2 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: accelerating ticks into a cut.

slots.role: Name the event and its dates
slots.visualRecipe: Accent ground. White capitals at 70% width, ghost of the same word 200% size behind it at 8% contrast; then the tile field with a date line.
slots.motionRecipe: Ghost drifts sideways; swap at 26.0 s; tiles light at random.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: strongest cut of the second half; let it hit.

slots.role: Recap with motion stopped
slots.visualRecipe: White ground with a faint engraving, small black number at 18% width. Accent ground, same size line.
slots.motionRecipe: Rollup is the only thing moving. Everything else frozen by 28.8 s.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: music carries; keep cuts on transients.

slots.role: A direct question
slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground. Heavy black two-line capitals, 50% width, centred.
slots.motionRecipe: No animation until the last 3 frames.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: could thin the mix for this moment; not established from the data.

slots.role: Call to action
slots.visualRecipe: Accent ground, rings from slot 2 again, a faint chart inside. White capitals at 70% width. Same words as the first part of the rule.
slots.motionRecipe: Push-in with rings, expo-out, chart draws.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: resolves.

slots.role: Product, address, mark, legal
slots.visualRecipe: Paper ground. Accent word at 40% width with address line; then mark, building into the name, with small legal lines at the bottom.
slots.motionRecipe: Hard swap at 33.17 s. Mark builds out by 34.4 s, then frozen.
slots.soundRecipe: Inferred: tail decays; measured energy falls at 34.9 s.

copySlot.purpose: Product word, address, legal as required

rhythm.cutGrid: Not a bar grid. Median shot 0.95 s, range 0.46-4.03 s. Under about 10 s cut freely on the beat where you can; after the music rises, put every cut on a transient within 0.08 s. Vary hold lengths: 0.6, 0.53, 0.87 s beats three equal ones. Only two sequences above 2 s.

style: One accent colour, near-white and black grounds changed by hard cuts; one heavy condensed face in capitals; one centred element; one faint moving layer at most; numbers animated rather than stated; three small object moments.

keep: Viewer cast into the outcome before the benefit is named
Motion stopping before the closing question
mustChange: All branding, marks, names and addresses
All graphics: object, sheet, engraving, background pictures and cards
All copy and all numbers, which must be true for the new product
Interface: must be the new product's real one
Legal wording: from the new product's own counsel
